context: Asuka lectures on perseverance and will.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: philosophy lecture; vocabulary (極めて/ゆえ/果たし/意志/ないし) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 目標を果たすには、強い意志が要ります。
lines.en: To achieve a goal, strong will is needed.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 意志ゆえに、人は粘れるんですね。
lines.en: Because of will, people can persevere.
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 極めて困難でも、諦めずに進みます。
lines.en: Even extremely difficult, we go on without giving up.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一人、ないし数人で、支え合うんですか?
lines.en: Do one or a few people support each other?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 仲間がいるゆえに、極めて強くなれます。
lines.en: Because we have companions, we grow extremely strong.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 役割を、果たしたいです。
lines.en: I want to fulfill my role.
lines.style: resolved young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 意志あるゆえに、君は果たせます。
lines.en: Because you have will, you can fulfill it.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 極めて大切な、学びでした。
lines.en: It was an extremely important lesson.
lines.style: moved young student voice, soft warm realization closing throughout
